from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    separators = [("row", r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    separators += [("col", c, grid[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # The separator divides the input into two equal-sized panels.
    for axis, k, _ in separators:
        if axis == "row" and k > 0 and (h-k-1) == k:
            a, b = grid[:k], grid[k+1:]
            break
        if axis == "col" and k > 0 and (w-k-1) == k:
            a = [row[:k] for row in grid]
            b = [row[k+1:] for row in grid]
            break
    else:
        raise ValueError("No equal-panel separator found")
    counts_a, counts_b = Counter(x for row in a for x in row), Counter(x for row in b for x in row)
    common = set(counts_a) & set(counts_b)
    base = max(common, key=lambda x: min(counts_a[x], counts_b[x]))
    return [[3 if a[r][c] == b[r][c] else base for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(len(a))]
